description: This file defines data structures and constants used for communication between components in a Cuttlefish Android virtualization environment. It includes request and response message types, build configuration structures, and operational status indicators.

classes.name: FetchArtifactsRequest
classes.description: Request message for fetching artifacts, containing a reference to an AndroidCIBundle.

classes.name: FetchArtifactsResponse
classes.description: Response message containing the AndroidCIBundle after fetching artifacts.

classes.name: ArtifactsBundleType
classes.description: Enumeration of different bundle types like main, kernel, bootloader, and system image.

classes.name: AndroidCIBundle
classes.description: Represents a build artifact bundle, including optional build info and bundle type.

classes.name: CreateCVDRequest
classes.description: Request structure for creating a Cuttlefish Virtual Device (CVD), with environment config and deprecated fields.

classes.name: CreateCVDResponse
classes.description: Response containing a list of created CVDs.

classes.name: AndroidCIBuild
classes.description: Details of a build from ci.android.com, including branch, build id, and target.

classes.name: AndroidCIBuildSource
classes.description: Specifies sources for various build components like main, kernel, bootloader, and system image.

classes.name: BuildSource
classes.description: Contains reference to an AndroidCIBuildSource, representing the source to build the CVD.

classes.name: Operation
classes.description: Represents the status of a long-running operation, with name and completion status.

classes.name: CVD
classes.description: Represents a Cuttlefish Virtual Device, including identifiers, status, build sources, and metadata.

classes.name: CreateSnapshotResponse
classes.description: Response containing snapshot ID after creation.

classes.name: StartCVDRequest
classes.description: Request to start a CVD, optionally from a specific snapshot.
